candidate: F-01 compiled surface pack / gameplay bridge v1

modules.evidence: 9,454 compiled visible cells read as a coherent high-density voxel actor at both gameplay resolutions.
24x authored-unit bridge produces an approximately 16 percent screen-height actor without changing the R09 camera.
The pale asymmetric bob and oversized compact head remain identifiable from front and three-quarter play views.
Skin, large teal eyes, fringe framing and expression from the Beauty/Build Sheet collapse into small dark noise at 1280x720.
The white technical coat, dark inner suit and front harness merge into a mostly gray vertical mass.
Semantic arms and legs animate correctly, but gloves, coat edge and leg separation are weak during motion.
The archive pack and cyan status panel do not produce a reliable gameplay-scale identity read.
The right-arm socket follows animation and inverse actor-scale compensation keeps both world-unit tools at gameplay size.
Idle and run are synchronized with authoritative movement and all four facing directions remain available through normal controls.
Windup, hit, recovery, hurt and skill are mechanically distinct, but their silhouettes are not yet strong enough at normal camera distance.
?actor=legacy bypasses the dynamic pack and starts R09A with the built-in R05 actor without browser errors.
